slides.headline: PEOPLE ARE USING THESE 6 AI PROMPTS TO CLOSE SALES DEALS WITHOUT A SALES TEAM
1) HANDLE THE OBJECTION THAT KILLS YOUR DEALS
slides.body: One wrong answer to 'too expensive' loses the deal. "Here are my 5 most common sales objections. For each, write a 2-sentence reply that reframes it using a specific number"

slides.headline: 2) WRITE THE COLD EMAIL THAT GETS A REPLY
slides.body: A great salesperson closes 1 in 10 cold emails. "Write a cold email to [name] at [company]. Mention their [recent win] and connect it to how [my product] solves their next problem"

slides.headline: 3) FOLLOW UP WITHOUT BEING ANNOYING
slides.body: 80% of sales close after the 5th follow-up, but most people quit after one. "Write 5 follow-up emails spaced over 3 weeks. Each adds new value instead of just asking 'any update?'"

slides.headline: 4) WRITE A PROPOSAL IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: Most proposals take a full day and still feel generic. "Here is what [prospect] needs. Write a one-page proposal: their problem, my solution, three results they'll get, and a price"

slides.headline: 5) TURN ONE CUSTOMER INTO THREE REFERRALS
slides.body: Referred leads close at 4x the rate of cold ones. "I just closed a deal with [customer type]. Write 3 messages I can send asking for referrals without sounding desperate"

slides.headline: 6) PREDICT WHICH LEADS WILL BUY
slides.body: Most people sell to everyone and close almost nobody. "Here are my last 20 customers. Find which traits predict a sale so I stop wasting calls on dead leads"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR YOUR NEXT SALE
slides.body: You'll want these prompts when money is on the line. Save it now. Daily AI news and real skills you can use tonight

caption:
Swipe for all 6 prompts 👇 These turn cold leads, lost deals, and dead follow-ups into closed sales

Handle the objection that kills most deals, write the cold email that actually gets a reply, send 5 follow-ups that add value instead of begging, write a one-page proposal in 60 seconds, turn one closed customer into three referrals, and predict which leads will buy before you waste the call

AI got good enough at writing this year that the sales copy it produces is now better than what most reps send. These 6 prompts are the starting lineup.

pinned_comment: Number 3 is the sleeper. 80% of deals close after the 5th follow-up and most people quit after one. Which prompt are you copying first?

hook_tournament.why: 'Sell while you sleep' is a universal fantasy that lands in under a second — zero context needed, everyone wants money while they're unconscious. The runner-up options either require you to have a sales team or take an extra beat to parse the transformation, which is already too slow at 2am.

hook_sharpen.why: "Deals you'd LOSE" is a gut punch — loss aversion hits harder than any promise of gain, and it's specific enough to feel personal without requiring setup. The runner-up ([2]) creates curiosity with "still don't use" but that FOMO formula is worn out; it makes me think "another secrets post" and keep scrolling.
